ModMetaData.name: Remember Me?
ModMetaData.author: frbyyy
ModMetaData.description:
Colonists from your old games are not gone. Once in a while one of them turns up in your new world.
Remember Me? reads your old saves in the background and keeps an archive of every colonist who ever lived in them, alive or dead. With a small chance, a pawn the game is about to create (a raider, a visitor, a trader, a wanderer, a slave for sale, a new faction leader) becomes one of those people instead: same name, face, traits, skills, backstory, genes and prosthetics.
Where they end up depends on who they were. Former ideology leaders and nobles tend to lead factions, veterans with many kills turn up in raids, merchants run caravans, tribal colonists join tribes, xenohumans join their own kind. Children from old colonies come back grown up.
Colonists who died get their own way back: they may walk in and ask to join, and with Anomaly they may come as a creepjoiner or shamble in among the dead.
Settings: chances, cooldown, letters on or off, which roles are used, which old colonies count.
---
Колонисты из ваших старых игр никуда не делись. Иногда кто-то из них появляется в новом мире: гостем, торговцем, рейдером, беженцем, рабом на продажу, лидером фракции или новым членом колонии. Кем станет человек, зависит от его прошлой жизни. Погибшие возвращаются отдельным событием, а с Anomaly приходят жутким странником или бродячим мертвецом.
